g.text: Original client data -> clean data layer -> 7 agents and code engines -> validation -> API -> dashboard -> named decision maker
CO-POL-014 trade terms and returns, C&F SOP,
QBR pack, interviews. Policy numbers are
copied into config.py with their page.
repeated sales rows and 23 repeated claims,
normalises codes and dates, sums split stock
rows. Ties to the QBR. Raw files are never
users, claims filed, claim chat, batch run
Every policy number with its page; every
judgement threshold with the evidence named
Routers: analytics, claims, chat, admin, auth. JWT
and 6 roles, rate limits, audit log. Serves the
static frontend from the same app. Returns latency,
tools called and model calls on code-only
batch/processor.py scores all 4,503 claims with the
claim checker; stores tiers, stock alerts and
classes; classes are never added together.
Agent layer: 7 agents, no central LLM orchestrator
Input, tool and output guardrails · 12-trip cap · numeric
grounding check on every Ask answer · reply-wording number
guard · evidence tiers T1 to T4 · 20-record check set
gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0. Reads questions, picks tools,
words replies. Never writes a figure.
Kavita Rao, Vaishali Kapoor: supply, monthly
Arjun Sethi, Rohan Mehta: schemes and cap,
A named person decides every credit
clean data is read by every agent
